title: The Next 700 Programming Languages
why: Frames the whole family of languages around a small applicative core (ISWIM).

title: An Axiomatic Basis for Computer Programming
why: Introduces Hoare logic and the pre/postcondition triple.

title: Towards a Theory of Type Structure
why: Introduces the polymorphic lambda calculus (System F).

title: Abstract Interpretation: A Unified Lattice Model for Static Analysis
why: The theory underlying essentially all sound static analysis.

title: A Theory of Type Polymorphism in Programming
why: Let-polymorphism and Algorithm W, the inference core of ML/Haskell.

title: Comprehending Monads
why: Brings Moggi's monads into practical programming.

title: Separation Logic: A Logic for Shared Mutable Data Structures
why: The frame rule and local reasoning about the heap.

title: The Java Memory Model
why: The first rigorous language-level memory model.

title: Gradual Typing for Functional Languages
why: Coins gradual typing and the consistency relation.

title: seL4: Formal Verification of an OS Kernel
why: First machine-checked correctness proof of a general-purpose OS kernel.

title: RustBelt: Securing the Foundations of the Rust Programming Language
why: First formal safety proof for a realistic Rust subset.
